title: Create app_theme.dart ThemeData builder
description: Create the unified ThemeData builder at lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart. Class `AppTheme` with private constructor `AppTheme._();`. Two static factory methods: `static ThemeData light()` and `static ThemeData dark()`. Each returns a `ThemeData` with `useMaterial3: true`, plus: `colorScheme` (the appropriate ColorScheme), `textTheme` (the appropriate TextTheme), `scaffoldBackgroundColor` (AppColors.backgroundLight for light, AppColors.backgroundDark for dark), `primaryColor` (AppColors.primary for light, AppColors.primaryLight for dark — mapped from scheme), `visualDensity` (VisualDensity.adaptivePlatformDensity). Additionally, set these component themes for both: `appBarTheme` (background: surface color, foreground: onSurface, elevation: 0, scrolledUnderElevation: 1, centerTitle: false, titleTextStyle from headlineMedium), `cardTheme` (color: surface color, elevation: 1, margin: EdgeInsets.zero, shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: Radii.card))), `filledButtonTheme` (style from primary background, white foreground, Radii.button, padding Spacing.md horizontal), `outlinedButtonTheme` (outlinedButtonStyle with primary border and primary foreground, Radii.button), `textButtonTheme` (primary foreground, no padding), `inputDecorationTheme` (filled: true, fillColor surfaceVariant, border: outline input border with Radii.input, focusedBorder primary, errorBorder error, contentPadding Spacing.md horizontal), `iconTheme` (color: onSurfaceVariant), `dividerTheme` (color: outline, thickness: 1, space: 1). Imports: material.dart, app_colors.dart, app_color_schemes.dart, app_text_themes.dart, app_spacing.dart, app_radius.dart. Top-of-file doc comment: explains Material 3 + Fredoka/Nunito strategy + how light/dark differ.
acceptance_criteria: All imports present: material.dart, app_colors.dart, app_color_schemes.dart, app_text_themes.dart, app_spacing.dart, app_radius.dart
Static method `AppTheme.light()` returns `ThemeData` with useMaterial3: true
Static method `AppTheme.dark()` returns `ThemeData` with useMaterial3: true
Light ThemeData uses `lightColorScheme` from app_color_schemes, `lightTextTheme` from app_text_themes
Dark ThemeData uses `darkColorScheme` from app_color_schemes, `darkTextTheme` from app_text_themes
Both themes set scaffoldBackgroundColor from AppColors (backgroundLight / backgroundDark)
Both themes configure component themes: appBarTheme, cardTheme, filledButtonTheme, outlinedButtonTheme, textButtonTheme, inputDecorationTheme, iconTheme, dividerTheme
All radii in component themes reference `Radii.xxx` (NOT literal numbers)
All paddings in component themes reference `Spacing.xxx` (NOT literal numbers)
Both ThemeData builders are reachable from a `main()` test compile (they don't require runtime args other than imports)
All string literals use double quotes
No emojis anywhere in the file
Top-of-file doc comment describes Material 3 + Fredoka/Nunito + theme strategy
